records.explanation: Variant B converted 44.4% of taps against 39.7% for A, a gap of about 4.8 points, which is well beyond the roughly 1.3-point margin of error at 95% confidence.
records.sql:
with t as (
  select
    sum(case when d.variant = 'A' then d.taps end) as n_a,
    sum(case when d.variant = 'A' then d.installs end) as x_a,
    sum(case when d.variant = 'B' then d.taps end) as n_b,
    sum(case when d.variant = 'B' then d.installs end) as x_b
  from reporting.experiment_daily d
  join reporting.experiments e using (experiment_id)
  where e.experiment_name = 'Product page: new screenshots'
),
r as (
  select n_a, x_a, n_b, x_b,
    x_a::numeric / n_a as p_a,
    x_b::numeric / n_b as p_b
  from t
)
select n_a, x_a, n_b, x_b, p_a, p_b,
  abs(p_b - p_a) > 1.96 * sqrt(p_a * (1 - p_a) / n_a + p_b * (1 - p_b) / n_b) as significant_95
from r

records.sql:
with e as (
  select experiment_id from reporting.experiments where experiment_name = 'Product page: shorter subtitle'
),
t as (
  select d.variant, sum(d.installs)::numeric as inst, sum(d.taps)::numeric as n
  from reporting.experiment_daily d
  join e using (experiment_id)
  group by d.variant
),
p as (
  select
    max(case when variant = 'A' then inst / n end) as pa,
    max(case when variant = 'B' then inst / n end) as pb,
    max(case when variant = 'A' then n end) as na,
    max(case when variant = 'B' then n end) as nb
  from t
)
select 100.0 * ((pb - pa) - 1.96 * sqrt(pa * (1 - pa) / na + pb * (1 - pb) / nb)) as ci_lower_pp
from p
